T2.purpose: Registry of climate-risk variables, without a composite climate-risk index.

fields.concern_id: Shared concern identity; do not count a T2/T5 alias twice
fields.classification_id: Reference to one versioned classification rule

T5.purpose: Registry of opportunity-space priorities and descriptors.

fields.concern_id: Shared concern identity, including climate variables also present in T2
fields.classification_id: Reference to one versioned classification rule

rule_fields.direction: Whether higher or lower raw values mean more concern
rule_fields.unit: Must match the input measurement unit
rule_fields.cuts: Three finite strictly increasing upper bounds in native units for thresholds
rule_fields.reference: For terciles: population/area and period of the explicit reference sample
rule_fields.none_condition: For terciles: explicit no-problem condition, or null when none is not established
rule_fields.context: Geographic and substantive scope of application
rule_fields.decision_ref: Recorded justification for the rule; not an inferred approval

critic: diagnostic_only; never automatically replaces or multiplies user weights
